name: status-check
description: /service-status checks whether GitHub, npm, PyPI or the Anthropic API are having an outage before you blame your code.

extra.title: Extra services
extra.description: Comma-separated Statuspage sites to check too, as Name=https://status.example.com (a bare URL is named after its host).

timeoutSec.title: Timeout (seconds)
timeoutSec.description: How long /service-status waits for each status page before reporting it as unreachable.

autoCheck.title: Check after network failures
autoCheck.description: When a Bash command fails with a network-looking error (timeout, 503, DNS) involving GitHub, npm, PyPI or the Anthropic API, look at that service's status page and tell Claude if there is an incident.
